column1: # The order of checks of a request to the service doors of the store daemon (P/01.3 N2). The norm refers to this table and does not repeat it in prose.
# The input of the table is the request after the HTTP framing of P/01.1 N2.1 and before its body is parsed as JSON: one object
# {method, path, query, size, role_header}. Rows in the order of n: the first row whose when is true gives the refusal code, kind and the fields fault;
# none — the request goes on to the body form of its door (P/01.3 N2) and then to the membership and state checks of its procedure (P/01.3 N3).
# The paths /v1/write, /v1/rights, /v1/get and /v1/list belong to chapters 1.1 and 1.2: of this table only the rows of the frame, the route and the method
# of their owners apply to them (row 1 there is the refusal body_limit of chapter 1.1, P/01.1-R034; service_body_limit — on the service paths);
# their identity, body and rights checks follow the order of their owners (P/01.1 N2.1, forms/write-checks.tsv, P/01.2 N3).
# The table does not know the mode: on a box a role header on any socket, admin.sock included, and a forwarding from the role configstore-door on -api are 403
# by P/01.2-R017 and P/01.3-R176, before the body; these rows are not in the table.
# op — * for every row: the request object has no op. group and each are empty: the table has no lists.
# when and fault are CEL (extensions strings, two-var-comprehensions; type(), has(), matches() — standard CEL). Variables:

#var body dyn — the request object: method — the HTTP method as sent (GET, POST, HEAD, …); path — the path of the request target, byte for byte; query — the string after ?, "" without one, no row reads it; size — the number of entity-body bytes, 0 without a body; role_header — the value of the role forwarding header, null without one
#var sock string — the caller role at this check, defined once by P/01.2-R017 (spec/01.2-store.norms.md, N3 check)
#var lone list<string> — not read by this table
#var lim map<string,int> — the parameters of the lesson, only the names of #lim; binding by name, not declaration order (P/01.1-R055)
#lim BODY_LIMIT — P/01.3 N1.3 the flag -max-body: the effective entity-body read limit of every request, whatever the method
# id — the stable address of the row, prefixed sc-, independent of check and the order n; not renamed or renumbered
# check — the refusal name in refusals.tsv; several checks may select the same refusal
